cohort: 849 infants with CDH born between 2006 and 2020 at 15 Japanese CDH study group facilities
finding: Prematurity was a significant risk factor for lower survival and intact-survival rates among infants with CDH, even after adjusting for CDH severity and other factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was used as a covariate in the analysis of survival rates of preterm infants with congenital diaphragm hernia.
